title: REQUAL-LM: Reliability and Equity through Aggregation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated primarily by measuring the disparity in cosine similarity between the text embeddings of the model outputs and the embeddings of different gender demographic groups (e.g., male vs. female). It is additionally measured by calculating the female-to-male representation ratio in subset selection tasks, and by counting the frequency of pro-stereotype, anti-stereotype, and neutral pronoun predictions in a masked language prediction task using the WinoBias dataset.

Measured during a chat completion task using the StereoSet dataset by calculating the cosine similarity disparity between the generated output's text embeddings and the vector representations of various racial demographic groups.
